## Description

Integration worker module: patient registration/search by EID at check-in, pull allergies, diagnoses, medicines, labs and discharge summaries into the timeline labelled with source; push every signed visit (HL7 v2/FHIR per programme). Status screen (N-07) shows connection health and per-encounter push status.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Conformance testing passed for the launch emirate (evidence stored).
- [ ] **AC2.** Pulled data appears with "Exchange" provenance and is never merged into verified chart data without clinician acceptance.
- [ ] **AC3.** Every signed visit is pushed with receipt; failures retry and are visible in N-07.
- [ ] **AC4.** India launch is not blocked if this slips (scope rule from PRD).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
